changelog: Sign-in is now purely passwordless: /login/email registers an unknown address, so the single email flow covers both sign up and log in.
Removed the username + password step, the /register and /forgot-password routes and their two pages — with no password there is nothing to forget and no separate sign-up.

The seven ds-*.svg illustrations were re-exported with real transparency (their embedded JPEG was un-matted to a straight-alpha PNG), so the #ds-unmatte filter that compensated for the dark rectangle is gone.
